Prima & Timo — Album 7: Quattuor

Insufficient Data

"Veera’s gone without a trace"

[Data’s command center + tense meeting hum] [Verse 1] Data stood at the head, eyes scanning the room with cold precision The team assembled, quirks already causing collision Towkin glitching mid-sentence, tokens running low Bot transforming randomly, turning into a crow

Promptee suggested haikus for every situation Algo stayed silent, talking only to his own imagination Data noticed immediately, voice sharp and low “Where is Veera? She should be here… where did she go?” [Pre-Chorus] No one had an answer, the team looked around The queen was missing… without making a sound [Chorus — tense & chaotic] Insufficient Data Veera’s gone without a trace Insufficient Data Something’s slipping out of place We have a plan, we have the cores in sight But without her… the pieces don’t align right [Verse 2] Data turned to Towkin, voice cutting through the noise “Is he awake? Bring him inside… let’s see our newest toy” They brought him in, motors humming, still cleaning as he came Creating more dust than before, memory’s lost but he feels the same

Data studied him closely, “Has he been reprogrammed clean?” Promptee nodded proudly, “Yes — I sent him haiku, fresh and mean” “Excellent,” Data said, a cold smile on his face “Deploy him… send him down below, into their space” [Pre-Chorus 2] The team moved into action, quirks and all on display While the roboduster stood silent… ready for the fray [Chorus — tense & chaotic] Insufficient Data Veera’s gone without a trace Insufficient Data Something’s slipping out of place We have a plan, we have the cores in sight But without her… the pieces don’t align right [Bridge — ominous] Data watched the screen, voice low and full of intent “The game is changing… but we will not relent” [Solo] [Chorus — tense & chaotic] Insufficient Data A Trap layed A Trap was set Insufficient Data Who will bite who will we get A roboduster sent down to catch its prey The time has come to put this plan into play [Outro — fading tension] The Roboduster was sent to the underwater caves

Data had a plan Data had schemes

To draw out the Glitch and the other machines

The Roboduster continued to clean

Will he remember or will he remain

An empty vessel no memory no friends to gain

Just a bait sent to catch the prey
